name: Jibble
description_en:
Jibble currently advertises free-forever employee time tracking for unlimited users. Its product combines attendance, timesheets, projects and optional identity/location controls across mobile, desktop and kiosk entry.

The requested pricing URL redirects to the current product page rather than a paid-tier table. This profile reports the actual free offer read and leaves enterprise/contract extras unresolved; it does not import older Premium prices from comparison articles.
description_zh:
Jibble 当前宣传面向不限用户的永久免费员工时间追踪，结合考勤、工时表、项目，以及手机、桌面和 kiosk 的可选身份/地点控制。

请求定价网址会跳转到当前产品页，而非付费档表。本文记录实际读取的免费宣传，企业/合同额外条件保留未知，不从旧比较文章引入 Premium 价格。

core_features.explanation_en: Clock from mobile/desktop/kiosk and review pay-period timesheets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 经手机/桌面/kiosk 打卡，审查工资周期工时表。

core_features.explanation_en: The product describes face/selfie, PIN/NFC and geofence/GPS controls.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品介绍人脸/自拍、PIN/NFC 及地理围栏/GPS 控制。

en: Prepare an organization, employees/groups, schedules, kiosk device and location rules. Compare a normal punch, a denied-location attempt and an offline entry after reconnection. The product describes offline synchronization and timesheet approvals, but their exact correction/locking behavior requires an account test.
zh: 准备组织、员工/分组、日程、kiosk 设备及地点规则，比较正常打卡、拒绝定位尝试和重新联网后的离线记录。产品介绍离线同步及工时审批，但更正/锁定细节需账户测试。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Official current free-forever unlimited-user claim; separate enterprise/support commercial conditions not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Official current free-forever unlimited-user claim; separate enterprise/support commercial conditions not established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方当前宣传永久免费、用户不限；独立企业/支持商业条件未明确。

sources.title: Jibble: FREE Time Tracking Software
sources.research_notes_en: Current free-forever unlimited-user positioning, attendance controls, project reports and exports.

sources.title: Jibble: FREE Time Tracking Software
sources.research_notes_en: Requested /pricing redirects to homepage with free-forever claim and enterprise/demo path; no paid amounts verified.

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a shared site kiosk and a mobile worker
sections.title_zh: 示例：现场共享 kiosk 与移动员工
sections.en:
Prepare an organization, employees/groups, schedules, kiosk device and location rules. Compare a normal punch, a denied-location attempt and an offline entry after reconnection. The product describes offline synchronization and timesheet approvals, but their exact correction/locking behavior requires an account test.

Face/selfie or GPS checks are documented controls, not a tested guarantee of identity or labor compliance. Establish a fallback for a failed check and review disputed entries before payroll. No device or biometric test was performed.
sections.zh:
准备组织、员工/分组、日程、kiosk 设备及地点规则，比较正常打卡、拒绝定位尝试和重新联网后的离线记录。产品介绍离线同步及工时审批，但更正/锁定细节需账户测试。

人脸/自拍或 GPS 是文档控制，不是已测身份或劳动合规保证。应为检查失败设置替代路径，发薪前审查争议记录。本次未测试设备或生物识别。

sections.title_zh: 免费宣传与商业未知项
sections.en:
The official current page says free forever and unlimited users. It also offers enterprise features and a demo path but the read pricing redirect does not expose a distinct paid table or quote. No paid amount is supplied and no claim is made that all enterprise support, hardware, third-party services or every future feature is free.

Confirm export, retention, API quotas and security entitlements for the intended deployment. Existing comparisons of older paid Jibble plans are not current price authority.
sections.zh:
当前官方页面写明永久免费、用户不限，也提供企业功能及演示入口，但读取的定价跳转没有独立付费表或报价。本文不填写付费金额，也不声称所有企业支持、硬件、第三方服务及所有未来功能免费。

应按计划部署确认导出、保留、API 配额及安全权益，旧 Jibble 付费方案比较文章不作为当前定价权威。

sections.en:
Attendance-focused employers can evaluate Jibble; a personal focus journal may not need employee verification. Define who may see location/identity data, approve time and correct entries. After a sync gap, reconcile the source timestamp before creating another record.

No privacy enforcement, payroll transfer, API, data deletion, software licence, self-hosting or restoration was verified. A Chinese article and language links do not establish full Chinese coverage for every application surface.
sections.zh:
以考勤为重点的雇主可评估 Jibble，个人专注日志未必需要员工验证。应明确谁可看地点/身份资料、审批工时和更正。同步间隔后，创建新记录前先核对原时间戳。

未核实隐私执行、薪资传输、API、数据删除、软件许可、自托管或恢复。中文文章和语言链接不证明每个应用界面完整支持中文。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Pricing redirects to product page; enterprise charges, full entitlements, licence, API and retention remain unverified. No live test.
research_gaps.zh: 定价跳到产品页；企业费用、完整权益、许可、API 及保留未核实，未实测。
